source.content: Account a1 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Object'); Account a2 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Object'); insert new List<Account>{a1, a2}; List<SObject> list1 = new List<SObject>{a1, a2}; List<Database.DeleteResult> d1 = Database.delete(list1); System.assertEquals(2, d1.size()); System.assert(d1[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(d1[1].isSuccess()); List<Account> deleted1 = [SELECT Id, IsDeleted FROM Account WHERE Id IN :new Set<Id>{a1.Id, a2.Id} ALL ROWS]; System.assertEquals(2, deleted1.size()); System.assertEquals(true, deleted1[0].IsDeleted); List<Database.UndeleteResult> u1 = Database.undelete(list1); System.assertEquals(2, u1.size()); System.assertEquals(2, [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id IN :new Set<Id>{a1.Id, a2.Id}].size()); Account a3 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Object Access'); Account a4 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Object Access'); insert new List<Account>{a3, a4}; List<SObject> list2 = new List<SObject>{a3, a4}; List<Database.DeleteResult> d2 = Database.delete(list2, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, d2.size()); System.assert(d2[0].isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(true, [SELECT IsDeleted FROM Account WHERE Id = :a3.Id ALL ROWS][0].IsDeleted); List<Database.UndeleteResult> u2 = Database.undelete(list2, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, u2.size()); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id = :a3.Id].size()); Account a5 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Object Boolean'); Account a6 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Object Boolean'); insert new List<Account>{a5, a6}; List<SObject> list3 = new List<SObject>{a5, a6}; List<Database.DeleteResult> d3 = Database.delete(list3, false); System.assertEquals(2, d3.size()); System.assert(d3[0].isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(true, [SELECT IsDeleted FROM Account WHERE Id = :a5.Id ALL ROWS][0].IsDeleted); List<Database.UndeleteResult> u3 = Database.undelete(list3, false); System.assertEquals(2, u3.size()); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id = :a5.Id].size()); Account a7 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Object Both'); Account a8 = new Account(Name = 'Delete List Object Both'); insert new List<Account>{a7, a8}; List<SObject> list4 = new List<SObject>{a7, a8}; List<Database.DeleteResult> d4 = Database.delete(list4, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, d4.size()); System.assert(d4[0].isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(true, [SELECT IsDeleted FROM Account WHERE Id = :a7.Id ALL ROWS][0].IsDeleted); List<Database.UndeleteResult> u4 = Database.undelete(list4, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, u4.size()); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id = :a7.Id].size()); Account a9 = new Account(Name = 'Delete Object Access'); insert a9; Object object1 = a9; Database.DeleteResult d5 = Database.delete(object1, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(d5.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(true, [SELECT IsDeleted FROM Account WHERE Id = :a9.Id ALL ROWS][0].IsDeleted); Account a10 = new Account(Name = 'Delete Object Boolean'); insert a10; Object object2 = a10; Database.DeleteResult d6 = Database.delete(object2, false); System.assert(d6.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(true, [SELECT IsDeleted FROM Account WHERE Id = :a10.Id ALL ROWS][0].IsDeleted); Account a11 = new Account(Name = 'Undelete Object'); insert a11; Object object3 = a11; delete a11; Database.UndeleteResult u5 = Database.undelete(object3); System.assert(u5.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id = :a11.Id].size()); Account a12 = new Account(Name = 'Undelete Object Access'); insert a12; Object object4 = a12; delete a12; Database.UndeleteResult u6 = Database.undelete(object4, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(u6.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id = :a12.Id].size()); Account a13 = new Account(Name = 'Undelete Object Boolean'); insert a13; Object object5 = a13; delete a13; Database.UndeleteResult u7 = Database.undelete(object5, false); System.assert(u7.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id = :a13.Id].size());
